solution: $\dfrac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}=2\sin\theta$, so $\sin\theta(\tfrac1{\cos\theta}-2)=0$. Thus $\sin\theta=0$ ($\theta=0,\pi$) or $\cos\theta=\tfrac12$ ($\theta=\tfrac{\pi}{3},\tfrac{5\pi}{3}$). Four solutions; note $\cos\theta=0$ is excluded.
